parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The data source of the exception. Set the value to sas.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: ResourceDirectoryAccountId
parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member in the resource directory.

>  You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to query the ID.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-susp-event-detail --source-ip 121.33.XX.XX --lang zh --suspicious-event-id 32750999 --from sas --resource-directory-account-id 1667036095600000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeSuspEventDetail --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '121.33.XX.XX' --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 1667036095600000 --Lang zh --From sas --SuspiciousEventId 32750999
